name: 3d-learning
description: The Third Dimension Learning Institute: student, tutor and owner portals (React + Express + SQL database)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: npx --yes concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
